routing_warnings.description: The message establishes separate steel entrance doors for each dwelling in addition to the common door; it concerns entrance-access topology rather than the number or room composition of the dwellings.
Moving the adjacent room wall by 28 cm is specifically intended to narrow the corridor and belongs to the independently defined corridor-space Requirement.
The same message separately relocates unit 3 bathroom drainage and the shower to the left wall.
The proposed vestibule wall primarily concerns incorporating the 6.8-square-meter area into unit 1, and no later client acceptance establishes it here as a partition-plan change.
Enlarging the bathroom to the turquoise line changes the narrower unit 1 bathroom layout.

The newly enlarged blue-marked area results from allocating the common vestibule space to unit 1, so it belongs to the unit 1 entry-area allocation Requirement rather than the established common-corridor optimization.
This fragment identifies a partition wall to be constructed in the corridor but does not independently modify the corridor-width or utilization objective.
This message concerns the kitchen-counter position and bathroom-door clearance in unit 3 rather than unit 1.
In the immediately preceding unit 3 context, this message proposes relocating kitchen counters and the bathroom door; it should not be assigned to the unit 1 kitchen.
This message explicitly concerns the alternative kitchen-counter placement in unit 3 rather than unit 2.
This message proposes swapping the kitchen and common bathroom in unit 1 rather than changing unit 2.
The same message also moves the unit 3 shower to the left wall; that unit-specific fixture placement belongs to the unit 3 bathroom layout.
The request to write sink and shower dimensions on the plan belongs to the plan-dimension annotation Requirement.
The requested change from a sliding door to a normal door concerns the independent unit 1 bathroom-door and collision-clearance behavior.
The bathroom-expansion clause applies to the target Requirement, but the inward-opening door and sink-clearance clause belongs to the separate door-clearance Requirement.
The toilet relocation applies to the target Requirement, while the request to write sink and shower dimensions on the plan belongs to the dimension-annotation Requirement.
The request to replace the unit 1 sliding bathroom door with a normal door concerns the independently tracked door-and-clearance behavior.
The request to show bathroom-door offset measurements is a plan-annotation requirement rather than an ensuite-layout change.
The proposed inward-opening unit 1 bathroom door and sink clearance concern the independent door-clearance Requirement.
The reported collision between the inward-opening door and sink is execution evidence for the door-clearance Requirement.
Adding the wall-to-door-edge measurement for the ensuite is a drawing-annotation obligation, not a change to the ensuite layout.
The request to show bathroom-door offsets from wall edges belongs to the plan-dimension annotation Requirement.
The question about the width of the unit 3 bathroom concerns the unit 3 bathroom layout.
The decision to enlarge the bathroom to the turquoise line changes the broader unit 1 common-bathroom layout rather than only its door clearance.
The reported collision concerns the opening direction and clearance of the Unit 1 bathroom door; it does not change the confirmed common or independent entrance-door topology.
The completed artifact reported here is the quick initial sketch; the refined layout is only promised for later.
The reported fit problem and alternative arrangement concern the Unit 1 ensuite layout rather than the detailed-plan artifact.
In context, the freelancer is adding the requested wall and door-offset dimensions.
The toilet-position clause concerns alignment with existing drains rather than dimension annotations.
The Unit 2 bathroom-door-position clause changes the physical bathroom layout.
The separate furniture drawing belongs to the furnished-layout deliverable.
The proposed change from a sliding to a conventional Unit 1 bathroom door concerns door configuration and clearance.
Moving the toilet closer to the marked drain wall concerns drainage alignment; the sink and shower annotation request repeats dimensions already requested in message 68.
The reported concern is clearance between the unit 3 kitchen counter and bathroom door.
The proposed blue bathroom-door position concerns the separate unit 3 door-clearance Requirement.
The message asks how to connect the unit 3 toilet drain to the existing waste pipe.
The freelancer's limitation concerns resolution of the WC drain connection.
The drain-location clause belongs to the cross-unit drainage-alignment Requirement; only the shower-location change is retained here.
The request is to display fixture measurements on the plan rather than change the unit 3 bathroom layout.
The request to show bathroom-door offsets and unit 3 bathroom width belongs to plan dimension annotations.
The request to show bathroom-door offset dimensions on the plan concerns drawing annotations rather than changing the unit 3 door-clearance behavior.
